title: Annotating Dimensions of Social Perception in Text: The First Sentence-Level Dataset of Warmth and Competence

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating large language models and fine-tuned models on their ability to predict underlying social perception dimensions of stereotypes (trust, sociability, and competence) in sentences targeting women.
Evaluating models on their ability to detect dimensions of social perception (trust, sociability, and competence) in sentences targeting religious people and non-religious people (atheists).

Assessing model predictions of warmth and competence (trust, sociability, competence) in sentences expressing stance and social perception towards specific political figures (Hillary Clinton, Donald Trump, Barack Obama) and activists (environmentalists).
